description: A small workshop manages orders, stock, prices and cash while its supplier changes prices. This is a new deterministic seeded instance of the existing bicycle-company environment, with its own starting world and a 12-decision campaign. Campaign completion records the end of observation, without claiming the goal was achieved. Goal: Keep the seeded workshop solvent throughout a 12-decision campaign while completing repairs, responding to supplier prices and maintaining exact cash, inventory and equity reconciliation.
